claims.text: The flag of South Korea has a red and blue circle at its centre, surrounded by black trigrams.
Japan's flag is a red disc on white, North Korea's shows a red star in a white disc, and Laos's shows a white disc on a blue band.
The circle on South Korea's flag is the taegeuk, a form of the yin-yang symbol.
The black bar patterns on South Korea's flag are trigrams from the I Ching.
